name: Baked Cod and Summer Squash in Foil Packets

ingredients.name: yellow summer squash, sliced into thin rounds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Season fish with salt and pepper. Arrange 4 large sheets of aluminum foil on a work surface and set 1 fish fillet on each piece of foil. Arrange zucchini, squash, and onion around each fillet and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle fish and vegetables with red chile flakes. Drizzle 1/2 tablespoon oil and 1/2 tablespoon wine onto vegetables and fish.

Arrange a few lemon slices on top of each fillet and top with a thyme sprig. Wrap foil around fish and vegetables, leaving some air space within each packet, and seal very well. Set packets on a rimmed baking sheet and bake for 8 minutes. Carefully open 1 packet to confirm fish is just cooked through; if not, re-seal packet and return to oven to continue cooking until cooked through. Serve right away, opening packets at the table.

description: This easy dish of cod cooked in foil packets with squash and fresh herbs is one of the easiest recipes to scale: it works the same whether you make it for one, two, three, four or fourteen people.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Crushed red pepper flakes, for sprinkling

Optional substitutions: cod fillets → mild white-fleshed fish

Notes: This recipe can easily be scaled up or down to serve as many or as few people as you like.
author: Yasmin Fahr
